text:
Aisha (CSM): Quick sync — BlueHarbor hit a recurrence of 503s during onboarding flows this morning. Customer reports failed file uploads and breaking their demo. Observed ~3 incidents between 06:12–06:40 UTC. Need RCA, mitigation owner, and an ETA for the customer update. Who can pick this up?

Diego (Account Lead): Assigning Tom to lead the tech investigation. I will take customer comms.

Tom (Support Eng): On it. First-pass: gateway turned 503s after upstream returned 502 in several requests. Pasting a short log excerpt below to start.
```
[06:12:14] upstream model-backend resp=502 id=79f2 path=/v1/generate
[06:12:14] gateway -> 503 id=79f2 client=blueharbor-xy
[06:16:03] repeated kv-cache-evict event, mem-pressure=true
```

Marta (Ops): fwiw I rolled a routing-policy change overnight that nudged a fraction of traffic to variant-A for better latency. Could be related. I can revert if needed.

Tom (Support Eng): Thanks @Marta. Deploy metadata also shows a config change at 05:58. @marta can you confirm the exact payload?

deploy-bot: Rolled config change routing-policy:v3 on blueharbor-prod at 05:58 UTC by marta_ops. No autoscale events triggered.

Aisha (CSM): Customer is asking for an interim mitigation and an ETA for a full RCA. They also want to know whether we'll cover credits if SLA was missed.

Tom (Support Eng): Hypothesis: the routing change bumped more requests to variant-A, which has tighter KV cache settings. Under onboarding bursts the cache thrashes, leading to upstream 502s that surface as 503s at the gateway. Plan: 1) rollback routing-policy to previous variant B for a short window, 2) run soak and collect detailed traces, 3) tune KV cache window and re-roll. Owner assignments: Tom -> lead investigation + RCA, Marta -> rollback & monitor, Diego -> customer comms, Aisha -> CSM follow-up and escalation path.

Marta (Ops): I can schedule rollback at 07:15 UTC and will keep a watch on error-rate and p95 latency. Will post metrics after 15m. :white_check_mark:

Tom (Support Eng): I repro'd the behavior in staging after simulating onboarding traffic. After rollback in staging error-rate dropped from 2.8% to 0.2% in 10m. ETA for formal RCA/postmortem: EOD today. I'll add the root cause, mitigation, and long-term actions to the incident tracker.

Diego (Account Lead): I'll send the interim customer note in 30 min: short explanation, rollback already scheduled, expected RCA timeline, and offer to discuss credits pending final impact analysis.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks — please flag renewal risk if customer pushes back. I'll coordinate enablement follow-up to ensure their demos finish.

Tom (Support Eng): Adding two short action items here for the tracker: 
- ACTION-1: run full trace correlation for 06:00–07:00 UTC (owner: Tom)
- ACTION-2: revert routing-policy on prod and validate soak results (owner: Marta)

Marta (Ops): Rollback done at 07:15 UTC in prod. Monitoring dashboard: error-rate trending down, p95 latency normalizing.

Tom (Support Eng): Verified logs after rollback: no new upstream 502 bursts. Will prepare RCA draft.

Diego (Account Lead): Interim note sent to BlueHarbor - they acknowledged receipt and will wait for the RCA. Also asked about SLA credits; I'll log that with finance if needed.

Aisha (CSM): Great. Let's reconvene after RCA draft. Thanks everyone. :pray: 

Tom (Support Eng): +1. Will update the incident ticket with the timeline and attach logs.

Marta (Ops): Keeping an eye on autoscale and routing metrics for the next 24h. Ping me if anything flares.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026-412 created and linked to thread.

Diego (Account Lead): Closing loop — owners confirmed. I'll add renewal-risk note and expected SLA impact to the customer health doc.

Aisha (CSM): Acknowledged. Thanks all.
